<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[Hezbollah–Israel conflict (2023–present)|Hezbollah–Israel conflict]]
***[[2026 Lebanon war]]
****The [[Israeli military]] claims to have killed multiple [[Hezbollah]] fighters during attacks on more than 70 targets in [[southern Lebanon]] over the past day. [https://aje.news/1n1bb7?update=4654561 (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Seven [[hikers]] are killed in separate [[avalanche]]s in the last 24 hours on [[Mont Blanc]] in the [[Alps]]. [https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/topnews/2026/06/13/morto-un-altro-alpinista-su-monte-bianco-e-il-settimo-in-24-ore_201341aa-d259-4dde-b52d-28eee61e25ce.html (Ansa)]
*Five people are killed, and another is seriously injured when an [[Indian Air Force]] [[Antonov An-32]] aircraft crashes while landing in [[Jorhat]], [[Assam]], [[India]]. [https://indianexpress.com/article/india/indian-air-force-plane-crash-in-assam-jorhat-10737534/?ref=hometop_hp (''The Indian Express'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/india/india-air-force-plane-crash-kills-all-five-onboard-2026-06-13/ (Reuters)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2026 Bangladesh measles outbreak]]
**The [[Directorate General of Health Services (Bangladesh)|Directorate General of Health Services]] reports that five more children in [[Bangladesh]] have died from [[measles]] in the past 24 hours. [https://www.bssnews.net/news/395560 (BSS News)] [https://en.bd-pratidin.com/national/2026/06/13/64287 (''Bangladesh Pratidin'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Anti-American sentiment in Iran]]
**Dozens of [[Iranian principlists|hardliners]] and pro-regime demonstrators [[2026 Iranian pro-government rallies|gather]] outside a [[Ministry of foreign affairs|foreign ministry office]] in [[Mashhad]], [[Iran]], to protest against [[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Iran)|foreign minister]] [[Abbas Araghchi]] and a [[2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations|potential deal]] between Iran and the [[United States]]. Protesters also call for a deal to not be signed without the approval of [[Supreme Leader of Iran|supreme leader]] [[Mojtaba Khamenei]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/dozens-protest-deal-with-us-outside-iran-foreign-ministry-office-local-media/ (''The Times of Israel'')] [https://www.i24news.tv/en/news/middle-east/iran-eastern-states/artc-iranian-hardliners-protest-against-emerging-deal-with-us (i24NEWS)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2026 UFL season]]
**[[2026 United Bowl]]
***In [[American football]], the [[United Football League (2024–present)|United Football League]]'s [[Louisville Kings]] defeat the [[DC Defenders]], 27–20, to win their first [[United Bowl (UFL)|United Bowl]] championship in their [[2026 Louisville Kings season|inaugural year]] in the league. [https://www.foxsports.com/stories/ufl/2026-ufl-united-bowl-results-defenders-kings-crowned-champions (Fox Sports)]
*[[2026 FIFA World Cup]], [[Qatar at the FIFA World Cup]]
**In [[association football]], [[Qatar national football team|Qatar]] earns their first [[Three points for a win|point]] in [[FIFA World Cup|World Cup]] history after drawing with [[Switzerland national football team|Switzerland]] 1–1 in [[2026 FIFA World Cup Group B|their group stage]] match. [https://www.thedailystar.net/sports/sports-special/fifa-world-cup-2026/news/qatar-earn-first-ever-world-cup-point-late-goal-4198116 (AFP via ''The Daily Star'')] [https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7357425/2026/06/13/qatar-vs-switzerland-world-cup-2026-score-results-takeaways/ (''The New York Times'')]
*[[2026 NBA Finals]]
**In [[basketball]], the [[New York Knicks]] defeat the [[San Antonio Spurs]] 94–90 in [[Playoff format#Best-of-seven playoff|Game 5]] of the [[NBA Finals]] to win their first [[Larry O'Brien Championship Trophy|championship title]] since [[1973 NBA Finals|1973]] and their third overall. [https://www.reuters.com/world/new-york-knicks-defeat-san-antonio-spurs-win-their-first-nba-title-since-1973-2026-06-14/ (Reuters)] [https://www.si.com/nba/finals/knicks-spurs-nba-finals-game-5-live-updates-scores-stats-takeaways (''Sports Illustrated'')] [https://www.sportsnet.ca/nba/article/knicks-defeat-spurs-to-win-first-nba-championship-in-53-years/ (Sportsnet)]
